d: Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.
r: We're seeking a Customer Care Associate for our Customer Experience team. In this role, you will be crucial in providing answers to customers queries through phone calls, website and live chat related to Tamara’s services. This role will be based in our offices in Riyadh and is onsite

Drawing on your proficiency in managing interaction with customers on a daily basis, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service through accurate information and tailored solutions that address their needs to create unique experiences only Tamara can provide.

With a proven track record of leveraging strong communication skills (written & verbal) to effectively solve customer issues and find solutions quickly, even in a fast-paced environment, and ultimately revolutionize the way millions of users shop, pay, and bank.

You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges.

You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.
Answer inbound phone calls, Emails and respond to live chats in an efficient manner.
Identify customer questions, concerns, and overall needs.
Provide accurate answers and solutions to customer queries.
Reviewing customer accounts and transactions while resolving issues.
Understanding and striving to meet support metrics while providing excellent customer service, and follow communication “scripts” when handling different topics.
Reviewing customer accounts and transactions while resolving issues.
Previous customer service experience is a plus.
Fluency in English Language, B2 profile.
Ability to solve problems in a short period of time.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

d: We are seeking a passionate, dynamic, and guest-focused Learning & Development professional who takes pride in developing people, creating engaging learning experiences, and supporting colleagues to deliver exceptional levels of service.

As a Learning & Development Officer, you will support the Human Resources Leader in managing the hotel’s training and development function, helping to foster a positive learning culture and drive continuous colleague development. The role includes identifying learning needs, coordinating and delivering training programs, facilitating workshops, and supporting departmental training initiatives based on operational and business requirements.
q: A degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Human Resources, Learning & Development, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in hospitality, training, Learning & Development, or Human Resources would be an advantage.
Good understanding of training methodologies, facilitation techniques, and colleague development practices .
Strong computer skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint , and other relevant learning or HR systems.
Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills , with the confidence to engage colleagues at different levels.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple training activities, maintain records, and meet deadlines.
The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning and developing others, with an enthusiastic and engaging approach to delivering structured training programs and workshops.

You should enjoy working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and across all levels of the organization, while demonstrating strong interpersonal, customer service, team-building, and problem-solving skills.
The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:
r: Analyse colleague learning and development needs across the hotel and recommend appropriate training interventions.
Support the development and implementation of the hotel’s annual Learning & Development plan in line with operational priorities.
Prepare and maintain monthly training reports, records, attendance, and development data .
Coordinate and facilitate training courses, workshops, and learning activities across the hotel.
Work closely with the Learning & Development Leader and Department Heads to identify and address departmental training requirements.

Coordinate and deliver a comprehensive orientation and onboarding program for all new colleagues, ensuring they receive the necessary job information, handbook, hotel guidance, and HR-related information.
Coordinate with Human Resources and the Housing team to ensure new colleagues receive appropriate accommodation orientation and relevant information .
Support and monitor on-the-job training for new and existing colleagues in coordination with Department Trainers and leaders.
Maintain the hotel’s Learning & Development resources, materials, training library, and related documentation .
Support the continuous development and re-development/upskilling of colleagues , particularly where operational or service improvement opportunities are identified.
Monitor the effectiveness of training programs and follow up with departments on learning outcomes and development actions.
Encourage colleague participation in learning initiatives and help create a culture of continuous learning, engagement, and development .
Support other Human Resources and colleague engagement initiatives when required.

d: The Marketing Brand Manager is responsible for developing and executing the local marketing strategy for Guerlain across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, ensuring full alignment with the regional and global brand vision.

The role will lead the implementation of 360° marketing campaigns, product launches, media activations, retail animations, influencer partnerships, CRM initiatives, and client engagement strategies to drive brand desirability, business growth, and exceptional client experiences. Working closely with regional teams, retailers, and external agencies, the Marketing Brand Manager will ensure Guerlain continues to strengthen its position as a leading luxury beauty brand within the Saudi market.
r: Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the Saudi market in alignment with regional and global objectives.
Adapt international campaigns to resonate with local market needs while maintaining brand consistency.
Manage the execution of product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retail marketing initiatives.
Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities based on business results and market insights.
Ensure excellence in brand visibility across all consumer touchpoints.
Support in external and internal strategic presentations
Partner closely with retail and commercial teams to drive traffic, sales, and brand awareness.
Define & develop the retail marketing & wholesalers trade marketing annual plans in collaboration with local commercial teams and regional trade marketing teams.
Ensure strong in-store execution across all Guerlain counters and boutiques.
Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to maintain premium brand presentation and execution for trade and VM permanent.
Ensure all regional PR guidelines are upheld and implemented locally in collaboration with the PR Manager and Communications team.
Share local market feedback and insights with the regional PR team to support alignment and close collaboration.
Support press and influencer appointments, events, and activations where needed, following the direction of the regional PR team.
Ensure the correct assets are selected and utilized appropriately in line with regional guidelines and brand requirements.
Ensure all assets are implemented correctly across relevant paid and social media channels.
Share local market feedback and insights with the regional team where possible.
Partner closely with the CRM team to ensure all CRM tools and initiatives are implemented and utilized correctly to enhance customer engagement.
Support clientelling activations to strengthen client relationships and drive engagement.
Support VIC experiences, ensuring a personalized and elevated customer journey.
Develop and manage the annual marketing budget (media, PR, trade), matching regional guidelines.
Monitor expenditures and ensure optimal ROI across all marketing investments.
Work with procurement and finance teams to ensure accurate budget tracking.
Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activities.
Analyze sales performance and marketing effectiveness.
Provide strategic recommendations to improve market share and brand performance.
Work closely with Retail, Commercial, Education, Supply Chain, Finance, Visual Merchandising, E-commerce, and Regional Marketing teams.
Coordinate with external agencies, suppliers, and partners to ensure flawless execution of all initiatives.
Achievement of sales and market share objectives.
Successful execution of marketing campaigns and product launches.
Strength of influencer and media partnerships.

5–8 years of marketing experience within luxury beauty, cosmetics, fragrance, fashion, or premium retail. Proven experience managing integrated marketing campaigns. Experience working with retailers and distributors in the Saudi market. Luxury brand experience is highly preferred.

d: A new AI-powered film and content production studio based in Dubai, specializing in AI-driven video and cinematic content.

Our client values ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work. The company fosters a culture of trust, providing team members with a high level of autonomy and freedom in decision-making rather than relying on micromanagement. At the same time, this autonomy comes with a strong sense of responsibility, the ability to make sound decisions, and readiness to take ownership of outcomes. Hands-on experience with AI tools and technologies is a mandatory requirement for this position.
q: A true hunter - a proactive salesperson who genuinely enjoys spending the day making calls, reaching out to prospects, following up, and initiating new business conversations.
Experience in media or advertising sales is highly desirable, but personal qualities and commercial drive matter more than the CV.

Strong commercial acumen: the ability to distinguish a prospect with genuine buying intent from someone simply wasting time, even during the first conversation, and to walk away from deals that do not make financial sense.
Highly organised: the client database must always be up to date, with a clearly defined next step for every lead, whether managed through a CRM or personal tracking system.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. If a deal stalls or falls through, the specialist treats it as their responsibility to find a solution and move things forward. Even when delays are caused internally - due to a lack of response or a missed call, including from the Head of Studio - they are expected to take initiative and push the deal forward.
r: Manage daily outbound sales activities through LinkedIn, email, and phone. Target regional corporate groups and brands that require content production and branding services, such as Majid Al Futtaim, Emaar, DAMAC, and similar companies.

Actively engage with the local business community, including Dubai startup events. When a startup needs a high-quality promotional video for Instagram, they should be coming to us - literally just across the street.
Bring potential clients to the studio and convert their interest into actual projects and orders, including Reels, commercials, and series.
Work closely with the Social Media Manager and Creative Director to define what exactly we sell and how we package and present our services to potential clients.
Take full ownership of the client portfolio, including the sales pipeline, follow-ups, client retention, and achieving KPIs agreed upon collaboratively.

Leverage the business networks of the project owners and Head of Studio to generate referrals and introductions to potential clients. Ensure a consistent flow of high-quality networking opportunities.

Develop relationships with content creators, including YouTubers and influencers, either as potential clients (e.g. producing videos featuring them in places they have never visited before) or as promotional partners for the studio, provided the collaboration makes commercial sense.
Evaluate partnership proposals and potential synergies. Focus exclusively on opportunities with genuine purchase intent. Avoid spending budgets on vanity metrics.
